_source: Pandora backend — per-plan feature entitlements for Neo Mail and Neo Sites, verified from the backend by Darrel and supplied 03 Sep 2026. Backend-verified, not read off a page.
_authority: THIS FILE OUTRANKS EVERYTHING ELSE WE HAVE. static.flock.co/meta/plan/feature/config/en-US.json gives Neo's verbatim feature NAMES but says nothing about which plan includes what. src/data/site-features.json was read off the marketing pricing table. Where they disagree, this file wins — it is what the backend actually grants.
_naming: Pandora calls it 'Titan MCP'. For our purposes that is NEO MCP — same capability, Neo's branding. Never render either string: it is disabled on every plan below, so it can never be a reason to buy.
_whyItMatters: Relevance and entitlement are different questions. features.ts answered only the first until 03 Sep, so it would happily print a feature the recommended plan does not grant. The gating fields in features.ts (minMailPlan / minSitePlan) are derived from this file.

mail._noLite: There is no Lite. It exists in the pricing sheet and is not sold — removed from plans.json and rules.ts on 03 Sep.

_gatingThatChangedOurCode.invoice_builder: MAX ONLY. Explicitly disabled on Starter and Standard.
_gatingThatChangedOurCode.titan_ai: MAX ONLY (Pandora 'Titan AI'). Absent from Starter and Standard.
_gatingThatChangedOurCode.appointment_booking: MAX ONLY — and it is a MAIL entitlement, not a site one. It does not appear in any site plan. We had it filed as a site feature.
_gatingThatChangedOurCode.signature_builder: MAX ONLY. Corrected 03 Sep by Hari. This file said 'STANDARD and MAX' and was stale; the published pricing table had it right. It is the one place Pandora has been wrong so far, which is why the tables are kept as a cross-check rather than deleted.
_gatingThatChangedOurCode.read_receipts: All three, but limited: Starter 50, Standard 90-day trial, Max unlimited.
_gatingThatChangedOurCode.advanced_tracking: All three, limited: Starter 5, Standard 5, Max unlimited.
_gatingThatChangedOurCode.ai_summary: All three, limit 4 on Starter and Standard.
_gatingThatChangedOurCode.drive_storage: Standard (1,024) and Max (51,200). Absent from Starter. Confirmed 03 Sep by Hari — here the PUBLISHED table is the stale one: it shows Drive as Max-only. Both agree it is absent from Starter, which is what makes it a real gate at the Standard line.

mail._storageGbNote: PER MAILBOX, not shared — Neo's catalogue says 'allotted for each mailbox that is created'. Confirmed against the live pricing table 03 Sep (15/50/100 GB). It is the #1 paywall trigger in docs/data-findings.md §5 at 32-52% of conversions in every industry.
mail._sendLimitConflict: This file says max 2000/day. Neo's live pricing page said 1000/day on 03 Sep (Starter 500, Standard 1000, Max 1000). Nothing reads sendLimitPerDay, so nothing is wrong on screen today — recorded so whoever resolves the other four conflicts resolves this one too. See src/data/mail-features.json _conflictsWithPandora.

site._confirmsTheMarketingTable: Every gate in src/data/site-features.json is confirmed by the backend, including the one that changed chooseSitePlan: the contact form is absent on Basic (Plus 1,000/month, Growth unlimited). Same for testimonials, remove-branding, WhatsApp and subscriptions — all Plus and above.

_openQuestion: rules.ts can only return Starter or Standard for mail, so MAX is unreachable — the same shape of bug that made `growth` unreachable for sites until today. Four features we carry (invoice builder, AI email writer, campaign mode, appointment booking) are Max-only and therefore can never legitimately appear. Either Max becomes reachable for a defensible case, or those four are dead weight. Not decided by guesswork: Max is roughly 5x Starter per mailbox, so it needs a real argument, not a feature match.
